description:
For riders looking to customize their race bike, Mongoose now offers the Title 24 cruiser as a frame only! The Mongoose Title 24 BMX race frame is designed for beginners or riders that are looking to get back on a Goose after a brief hiatus. This frame gives you performance and style at an amazing price!
Full Tectonic T1 aluminum frame with BMX race geometry.
Integrated headset and internal cable routing.
21.75" top tube length and frame weight of 3.44 lbs.
